description: This file defines the 'Create' feature for user registration within the Conduit application. It contains the command, validator, and handler classes responsible for processing user creation requests, validating input, checking for existing users, creating new user records, and returning user details with a token.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Encapsulates the user creation feature, including the command, validator, and handler classes for processing user registration requests.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the create user command: validates for existing username and email, hashes the password, creates and saves the Person entity, and returns a UserEnvelope with a generated token.

methods.name: CommandValidator
methods.description: Validates that username, email, and password are not null or empty.
